StudioPage.label: M2B STUDIO · HARGEISA
StudioPage.supporting: M2B is an independent technology innovation studio based in Hargeisa, Somaliland. We operate at the intersection of sovereign infrastructure, enterprise operations, and community culture.

philosophy.title: A studio built on rigor, not buzzwords.
philosophy.p1: In developing markets, software often breaks at the seams: when a field inspector enters a mountain valley with no cellular reception, when parents wait for critical student SMS transcripts, or when a telecommunications ministry needs an auditable record of spectrum rights.
philosophy.p2: M2B was founded to establish a gold standard of local craftsmanship. We don't rebrand cookie-cutter WordPress templates. We architect tailored solutions using industry-proven stacks — Laravel, Filament, Flutter, .NET, Next.js, and PostGIS — built to withstand decades of operational expansion.

principles.one: Zero offshore subcontracting — 100% in-house engineering and oversight.
principles.two: Deep local partnerships with Somaliland ministries, telecos, and enterprises.
principles.three: Bridging Hargeisa engineering talent with Somali diaspora networks globally.

team.label: STUDIO TEAM
team.title: Three partners. One studio.
team.supporting: We build and run M2B as equals — shared ownership, shared decisions, no hierarchy.

abdirahmaan.name: Abdirahmaan Mire
abdirahmaan.bio: Senior software developer and project manager with 9+ years in production systems. Focuses on architecture, technical discovery, and delivery across government registries, education ERPs, and high-load consumer apps — offline-ready data models and local mobile money flows.

mohamed.name: Mohamed Bulbul
mohamed.bio: Senior software developer and project manager with the same engineering depth — architecture, full-stack delivery, and operational systems. Partners on every technical milestone from discovery through ship.

adnan.name: Adnan Bille
adnan.bio: Heads marketing, sales, and everything non-technical — client relationships, positioning, partnerships, and go-to-market. Keeps the studio connected to ministries, enterprises, and the diaspora network.

local.label: THE LOCAL REALITY BENCHMARK
local.title: We speak the local stack fluently.
local.supporting: Western frameworks assume fiber optics, credit cards, English UI, and Monday-to-Friday schedules. M2B designs from first principles for the realities of the Horn:

money.title: ZAAD & eDahab Mobile Money
money.body: Direct merchant API integrations, automated reconciliation, and dual USD/SLS currency pricing.

typography.title: Somali & Arabic Typography
typography.body: Somali labels are 20-35% longer than English. We design dynamic layouts that never clip or hyphenate awkwardly.

offline.title: Zero-Cellular Field Resilience
offline.body: Offline SQLite synchronization for inspectors auditing telecom towers or cleaning supervisors in basement parking.

calendar.title: Saturday–Wednesday Cycles
calendar.body: Academic calendars and governmental shifts natively follow regional workweeks without messy calendar hacks.
